Work with the HappyProto plugin registry

Usage: hpy registry [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  login   Sign in to the registry with your atproto account
  logout  Sign out of the registry and forget stored credentials
  whoami  Show who you are signed in to the registry as
  plugin  Manage your HappyView plugins in the registry
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
